exposure: specific fetal cardiac diagnosis (e.g., single-ventricle, two-ventricle, aortic obstruction)
outcome: acidosis at delivery (determined by cord blood gas analysis, specifically umbilical artery pH)
cohort: The study included 134 newborns with prenatally diagnosed congenital heart disease and 134 comparable control newborns without congenital heart disease.
finding: Newborns with congenital heart disease showed no significant difference in umbilical artery pH at delivery compared to controls, suggesting compensated in utero circulation.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery with a progressively longer duration of labor was associated with a declining median umbilical artery pH in newborns with congenital heart disease.
